visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close up of a vending machine or display case inside a store. It showcases red signage with dates July 11th to July 17th and several toy models including a red fire truck, a white police car, and Hello Kitty figurines. Large yellow text is superimposed at the bottom. (2) Medium shot of a female with glasses and a red baseball cap holding a promotional paper advertisement. She is indoors with soft lighting. She points her finger at specific icons on the paper which depict various Hello Kitty toy accessories and sets. (3) Static shot of a brown paper McDonald's bag and a light blue box with Hello Kitty and watermelon illustrations sitting on a white table. Pink text labels the items in the center of the frame. The background shows a modern restaurant interior. (4) The woman in the red cap is seen hugging a Hello Kitty plush toy tightly against her cheek, eyes closed and smiling broadly. Soft pink heart graphics appear on the screen to emphasize her affection for the item. (5) The woman sits at a table and enthusiastically pulls open the top of the blue Hello Kitty box. Her hands move quickly, and her facial expression is one of excitement and anticipation as she unboxes the toy inside. (6) Close up of the woman holding a small blue plastic cup with a tanned Hello Kitty head on the lid. She rotates the object to show the back, pointing out a small circular opening specifically designed for a straw. (7) Another woman with glasses and a white sleeveless top is shown sitting in a restaurant booth. She holds a blue toy surfboard and demonstrates how it detaches to serve as a popsicle mold, smiling towards the camera throughout.
